tagline: A consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses operating in the center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice and food ingredient categories.
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. Consolidated net sales is selected as the primary KPI by default, representing the company's overall performance in a mature and cyclical sector.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales after reductions, discounts and returns.
kpis.description: Net sales increased by 3% in 2025, driven by the Foodservice segment, despite declines in other segments.
kpis.signal: Modest organic growth despite inflation and health-related disruptions.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before financial expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating profit increased slightly by 1%, impacted by a goodwill impairment charge of $29.8 million.
kpis.signal: Stable operating margin despite high input costs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Estimated from net sales and operating profit, taking into account general and impairment charges.
kpis.signal: Gross margin typical of the food distribution sector.

kpis.name: Net Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Total cost of borrowings after interest income.
kpis.description: Interest expenses increased by 14% due to a higher weighted average interest rate (5.3% in 2025 vs 5.1% in 2024).
kpis.signal: Increased pressure on financing costs due to higher interest rates.

kpis.name: Effective Tax Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of pre-tax income paid in taxes.
kpis.description: The effective tax rate increased from 22.3% in 2024 to 24.5% in 2025.
kpis.signal: Higher rate due to temporary tax variations.

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net earnings declined by 8% in 2025, due to higher interest expenses and an impairment charge.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in net earnings despite revenue growth.

kpis.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) Disruptions
kpis.explanation: Impact of highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks on egg supply and cost volatility.
kpis.description: HPAI outbreaks caused egg supply volatility in 2024 and 2025, with expected impact in 2026. The company anticipates continued volatility.
kpis.signal: Recurring major risk for Foodservice and Refrigerated Retail segments.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Potato Products of Idaho (PPI)
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of a manufacturer of refrigerated and frozen potato products to strengthen the Foodservice and Retail segments.
kpis.description: Acquisition completed on March 3, 2025, integrated into the Foodservice and Refrigerated Retail segments.
kpis.signal: Strengthens position in refrigerated products and foodservice.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 8.158 Bn USD for latest fiscal year (FY2024).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.336 Bn USD for latest fiscal year (FY2024).

risks.title: Input Costs
risks.score_rationale: Input costs, such as ingredients, packaging and energy, may increase due to factors such as inflation, tariffs and shortages, which could negatively impact the company's financial results.

risks.title: Agricultural Risks
risks.score_rationale: Agricultural diseases and pests, such as HPAI, may negatively impact the quality and availability of raw materials, as well as production costs.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions, such as delivery delays or raw material shortages, may negatively impact the company's financial results.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Macroeconomic conditions, such as inflation, tariffs and financial market fluctuations, may negatively impact the company's financial results.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity incidents, such as data breaches, may negatively impact the company's financial results.

risks.title: Labor Shortages
risks.score_rationale: Labor shortages, particularly regarding key employees, may negatively impact the company's financial results.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events, such as conflicts and international tensions, may negatively impact the company's financial results.
